Round 4: FamilySearch names Christmann's wife Elssa, not Margaretha; conflict recorded.

bio: FamilySearch does not have a Margaretha as wife of Christmann Grub: it names his wife (mother of Veltes 1615 and Caspar 1616) as 'Elssa', born 11 Apr 1597, with no source beyond a marriage index entry ([R4-S1]). The site's Margaretha is therefore unsupported by the tree that the site's Grub line otherwise follows; her name needs the Niederbrombach baptism of Caspar (26 May 1616), which should name the mother.
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Elssa (G9MF-6ML), wife of Christmann Grub (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/G9MF-6ML
